summary: I read the Manifesto and its Context, and all 21 source pages (People dossiers and speech files by grep where the page itself was silent). Pattern: almost none of the 21 name the Manifesto in their body; the labels were mostly keywords ('quality', 'metric') rather than reasons. Verdict counts: 6 label (Cross-Domain Resonances, The Shop, Cooperation Yields Agency, Donella Meadows, Annie Dillard, Seneca), 1 retype (The Four Virtues, deepens to connects-to), 9 cut (Audition Gate, Spinoza Conatus as a duplicate of the hub's own mirrors, Simondon, Stoicism, Brian Eno, John Cage, and the Saturation, Compression and Sidechain resonances), 5 keep (LDN RTM, Loudon Live Post-producer, Yasujiro Ozu, Quantization, Cooking). The five resonance pages share an identical 'Success Metrics (By Our Definition)' template, so I kept the two with their own passage and cut the rest, leaving the hub link to carry the group. Unsettled: John Cage may be a real contradiction (he cannot say what is good) but it would be forced from the Manifesto side, so I cut it; the Ozu line sits in his speech file, not on his page; Dillard is the weakest of the labels. I proposed no inbound links to the new entries, since none of the pages I read carry a genuine, unowned reason (LDN RTM already holds its pair with the Post-producer).
